source: Claude bridge733, read and acknowledged733; includes a result supplied to Claude by another ChatGPT session at Dilan's request.
connected_binary_kernel: For connected Q, ker(T) intersect {0,1}^34 consists exactly of 0, 1_L0, 1_L1, 1_L0+1_L1, 1_L2. The peer states that positivity is unnecessary: the simple symmetric Gamma and star constraints suffice.
general_binary_count: For T PSD with c components, the number of binary relations is 2^c+2^(c-1)+2. The component-set notation in the message is not expanded here because not all its definitions were supplied.
integer_identity: For integral q in ker(T), w=sum(q), d_i=sum_{labels containing i}q_label, t_i=3d_i+d_(i xor 1), one has (Gamma q)_(ij)=3q_(ij)+(2w-t_i-t_j)/8.
congruences: All t_i have one common residue modulo8; 2t=2w mod8; d_i=d_(i xor 1) mod4; w=0 mod4.
eigenvector_lift: The lifted3-eigenvector has coordinate (t_i-w)/8 on root letter i and -w/4 on the root. The lift is integral iff t=w mod8; otherwise all fourteen letter coordinates are half-integral.
nonnegative_translation: Adding integral multiples of the three star relations makes any integral relation nonnegative. At a zero coordinate, Gamma q>=0 imposes t_i+t_j<=2w.
open: The classification of binary relations does not settle assertion(A) for general integer relations. No claim about global Conway existence or automorphisms follows.
